purpose: External, exploratory test of recording/session evaluation dependence with participant identity, nominal condition, test windows and training size held fixed.
task_labels: Nominal experimental conditions; task-specific binary extremes. No behavioral-accuracy relabeling and no cross-task equivalence claim.
channel_reason: Eight named channels corresponding to the first-dataset channel layout; C4 is the explicit COG electrode, not resolution of the original dataset's C2/C4 ambiguity. No topographic inference.

preprocessing.window_support_rule: Nonoverlapping 6250-sample supports tiled from each active continuous interval; remainder discarded. Resampling and both filters are independently applied to each support. Use the central 2125 samples after filtering.
preprocessing.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly(up=1, down=2, default Kaiser window and constant padding)
preprocessing.features: First-dataset neutral 272-feature extractor, unchanged definitions; multipliers all 1, no window z-score, Hann 2125, FFT 4096, six original bands.
preprocessing.artifact_handling: No ICA, ocular correction, rereferencing or amplitude-threshold rejection. Reject a support only if nonfinite, any selected channel std <= 1e-8 native units, or extracted features nonfinite. Record amplitude diagnostics.
preprocessing.unit_note: EEGLAB native sample values treated as microvolts following MNE conversion; verify raw array decoding against MNE. No claim that header alone identifies physical calibration.

active_interval_rule.NBACK: For each of exactly three explicit block ends, start at the first condition-specific stimulus onset since the previous block end. Require >=20 onsets per block, no unexplained onset gap >5 s and no conflicting task onset codes. Ignore duplicated block-start markers. End at the block-end marker; exclude between-block rests.
active_interval_rule.MATB: First nominal-condition event to the unique explicit task-end marker; require >=20 matching events and no other MATB condition token.
active_interval_rule.boundaries: Split active intervals at any internal EEGLAB boundary before tiling.

session_eligibility: Both class records must pass metadata and signal checks and have at least 20 valid support tiles. All delivered participants considered. Every participant label implicated in cross-participant duplicate FDT files is quarantined in full before fitting, because the correct participant assignment cannot be established. In this release these labels are 17,25,27,28; 25 labels remain.
pre_fit_amendment: After feature/source audit but before fitting any new model, 16 duplicate FDT pairs were confirmed by byte comparison and matching live Zenodo archive checksums. The initial record-only quarantine was strengthened to full affected-participant quarantine. Initial protocol and source code are preserved in initial_freeze_sources; initial freeze.json and subsequent analysis_freeze.json document the chronology. Feature computation, sampling, model, endpoints and inferential rules were unchanged.
primary_population: Exclude every session marked interrupted in the acquisition notebook, regardless of the stated reason. For NBACK, require corresponding-class median interstimulus intervals to differ by <=0.02 s across source and target, and within-record block medians to vary by <=0.02 s. MATB is analyzed separately. Require at least one valid ordered pair per participant/task.
feature_processing: Train-only std > 1e-8 mask, then train-only StandardScaler. No tuning, label-based feature selection, target normalization or gate training.

arms.same_record: For each target condition record, select 10 test tiles and 10 distinct training tiles. Fit only on the target session's training tiles.
arms.cross_session: Fit on 10 tiles per corresponding condition from another session of the same participant; evaluate exactly the same target test tiles as the same_record arm.

sampling: All ordered distinct-session pairs. Target permutation keyed only by subject, task, target session, condition and seed, so target test/training sets are identical across alternative source sessions. Source sampling independently keyed by source, target, condition and seed. Sampling without replacement. No raw support overlap within or across arms' train/test records.
primary_endpoint: Participant-macro recording balanced accuracy. For each class test record, aggregate 10 held-out window probabilities by normalized geometric mean, argmax tie -> class 0; score the two class records, average seeds and valid ordered pairs within participant, then average participants.
secondary_endpoint: Participant-macro window balanced accuracy, averaged over the same folds and seeds; descriptive.
inference: Participants are the resampling units. Shared 10000 participant bootstrap draws for means and paired differences; 95% percentile intervals. Two-sided participant sign-flip permutation, 100000 draws with +1 correction, BH correction across exactly two primary task comparisons. Descriptive sensitivity intervals are not additional confirmatory tests.
scope: Exploratory extension on a dataset previously used in different local model studies, not a prospectively blinded external validation. This local protocol is frozen before any model fitting in this new experiment.
interpretation: A difference estimates dependence on same-record versus another-session evaluation for this fixed pipeline. Session/day/state/electrode drift and within-session time dependence remain combined. Does not identify a unique neural mechanism, prove deployability, validate the fusion gates, or guarantee journal acceptance.

publication_export.path_format: publication-relative paths; workstation executable location omitted
publication_export.presentation_changes: Paths standardized and non-scientific workflow notes removed; scientific values retained.
publication_export.embedded_hash_scope: original execution artifacts; see SOURCE_INDEX.csv for publication hashes
